# Tokens

<!-- Generated by frontend/scripts/tokens-doc.mjs from frontend/src/app/globals.css. Do not edit:
change the stylesheet (or a family in the script) and run, from frontend/,
bun scripts/tokens-doc.mjs > ../docs/internal/frontend/foundations/tokens.md
src/docs-catalogue.test.js fails while this page differs from what the script prints. -->

Every token lives in `frontend/src/app/globals.css`, on `:root` or in an `@theme` block. That is the
only place a colour, a shadow or a scale step is named. A call site writes the utility, never the
value. A theme name that only points at a `:root` token is listed as that token's utility; the
value is the stylesheet's own, and "touch" is what a coarse pointer gets instead. `cn` in
`lib/utils.ts` is told about every theme name that shares a group with a stock one (a size, a
layer, a radius, a duration), or tailwind-merge drops it ([`type.md`](type.md)).

## Colour

### Grounds

The window under the page, then the ladder a surface steps up: page, block, floating surface, control; a panel's ground is the one its insides are drawn over. Rules: [`surfaces.md`](surfaces.md).

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ground` | `oklch(0.145 0 0)` | `bg-ground` | #0a0a0a |

| `--background` | `var(--canvas)` | `bg-background` |  |
| `--card` | `oklch(0.183 0 0)` | `bg-card` |  |
| `--popover` | `oklch(0.2 0 0)` | `bg-popover` |  |

## Scales

### Type

The product's own steps, each with its line height; Tailwind's `xs`, `sm`, `base` and `2xl` sit between them. On a touch screen hint and micro step up (T1). Rules: [`type.md`](type.md).

| Token | Value | Utility | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--text-micro` | `0.6875rem` / `0.875rem`; touch `0.6875rem` / `0.9375rem` | `text-micro` | 11px — eyebrows, tags, the smallest legible mark |
| `--text-hint` | `0.75rem` / `1rem` | `text-hint` | 12px — a row's secondary line |
| `--text-xs` | `0.8125rem` / `1rem` | `text-xs` | 13px — a table cell, a status word, a tooltip |
| `--text-body` | `0.875rem` / `1.25rem` | `text-body` | 14px — body and row text; the product's default |
| `--text-sm` | `0.9375rem` / `1.25rem` | `text-sm` | 15px — an option row's title |
| `--text-title` | `1rem` / `1.375rem` | `text-title` | 16px — the title of a surface, and a section head |

### Motion

Two curves, four durations and four animations; `prefers-reduced-motion` and `data-motion="paused"` collapse them (T2). Rules: [`motion.md`](motion.md).

| Token | Value | Utility | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ease-arrive` | `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` | `ease-arrive` |  |
| `--ease-standard` | `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1)` | `ease-standard` |  |
| `--duration-fast` | `150ms` | `duration-fast` | a hover colour, a row's verbs, a chevron turning |
| `--duration-base` | `200ms` | `duration-base` | an overlay arriving, a drill, a block rising |
| `--duration-slow` | `300ms` | `duration-slow` | a sheet sliding, a cross-fade |
| `--duration-fill` | `500ms` | `duration-fill` | a meter or bar filling to its new reading |
| `--animate-breathe` | `jd-breathe 2.6s var(--ease-standard) infinite` | `animate-breathe` |  |
| `--animate-rise` | `jd-rise var(--duration-base) var(--ease-arrive) both` | `animate-rise` |  |
| `--animate-sweep` | `jd-sweep 1.4s var(--ease-standard) infinite` | `animate-sweep` |  |
| `--animate-drill` | `jd-drill var(--duration-base) var(--ease-arrive) both` | `animate-drill` |  |

### Control sizes

A control's box by density; a touch screen takes the taller step. Rules: [`layout-phone.md`](layout-phone.md).

| Token | Value | Utility | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--control-dense` | `1.5rem`; touch `2rem` | `h-control-dense`, `size-control-dense` | 24 — pane chrome, grid toolbars |
| `--control-compact` | `2rem`; touch `2.5rem` | `h-control-compact`, `size-control-compact` | 32 — the default in pages |
| `--control-regular` | `2.25rem`; touch `2.75rem` | `h-control-regular`, `size-control-regular` | 36 — forms and dialogs |
| `--control-large` | `2.5rem`; touch `3rem` | `h-control-large`, `size-control-large` | 40 — a flow's commands |

Stacking by name; each step says what lives there. Rules: [`layout-phone.md`](layout-phone.md).

| `--z-index-raised` | `10` | `z-raised` | a sticky cell, a chip over a chart, a pinned column |
| `--z-index-sticky` | `20` | `z-sticky` | the top bar, sticky headers, split and resize handles |
| `--z-index-pane` | `30` | `z-pane` | a side column laid over the work below lg, a drop target |
| `--z-index-float` | `40` | `z-float` | the floating save bar and the docks: one bottom stack |
| `--z-index-immersive` | `45` | `z-immersive` | full-screen map, ER diagram, terminal, remote screen |
| `--z-index-overlay` | `50` | `z-overlay` | dialog, sheet, popover, menu, hover card, lightbox |
| `--z-index-tooltip` | `55` | `z-tooltip` | above the dialog it may sit in |

Tailwind's own, written out because `lib/breakpoints.ts` mirrors them for script. Rules: [`layout-phone.md`](layout-phone.md).

| `--breakpoint-sm` | `40rem` | `sm:` | 640 — a field row stops stacking |
| `--breakpoint-md` | `48rem` | `md:` | 768 — the sidebar appears |
| `--breakpoint-lg` | `64rem` | `lg:` | 1024 — a workbench shows its side column |

## Classes

The stylesheet's own utilities: `focus-ring`, `focus-ring-within`, `focus-ring-inset`, `hit-area`, `transition-fill`, `glyph-inline`, `code-inline`, `pt-safe`, `pb-safe`, `pl-safe`, `pr-safe`, `px-safe`, `mb-safe`, `row-dim`, `flow-rule`, `checkerboard`. The component classes: `.eyebrow`, `.caps`, `.numeric`.
The safe-area utilities pad by the device's insets ([`layout-phone.md`](layout-phone.md)).

Classes one feature's markup carries: `.auth-backdrop`, `.auth-art`, `.scroll-affordance`, `.monaco-host`, `.terminal-history`, `.agent-streaming`, `.agent-attention`.

## Removed in 0.9.0

Nothing read them: `--warning-foreground`, `--signal-foreground`, `--sidebar-primary`,
`--sidebar-primary-foreground`, `--sidebar-ring`, `--plot-signal`, `--plot-primary-hover`,
`--shadow-color`, `--shadow-2xs`, `--shadow` and `--shadow-2xl`, and the phantom `mark-*` names
`cn` had been told about. `--destructive-foreground` stays: the danger face's label reads it.
